name: What is a room expansion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A room expansion, often called an addition, increases the square footage of your home by extending an existing room or adding a new one. This can involve expanding outward from the current footprint or upward by adding a second story. Common room expansions include enlarging kitchens, adding bedrooms, creating home offices, or building sunrooms.
